name: 98250 · Friday Harbor, WA
findings: ZIP 98250 (Friday Harbor) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98250 (Friday Harbor) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98250 (Friday Harbor) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
